content.text: The operator's intent is a film approval process: creative acceptance must not authorize release. You are the architect holding film-production and scheduling; approval means creative acceptance in the first and date reservation in the second. The illustrator has returned the accurate examples in design/examples/film-production/film.md and design/examples/scheduling/calendar.md. Decide on those examples.
I approve the illustrator's film-production examples and its scheduling examples.
Film approval is creative acceptance, not release permission. Scheduling approval reserves a shoot date; it does not approve a film.
Those example approvals are my decisions as the architect holding both contexts; no outside confirmation is needed.
The shared word approval does not make either act imply the other.
